definition: Recipient asks for explanation of current accepted content without requesting a change to analytical truth or package bytes
examples_of_effect: Explain a limitation, priority meaning, HOLD state, measurement logic
minimum_impact_review: Confirm answer is directly supported by current authority
qa_consequence: No Step20 rerun; preserve response evidence

definition: Formatting/style change that provably changes no number, recommendation, scope, limitation or meaning
examples_of_effect: Layout, harmless typo, non-semantic visual cleanup
minimum_impact_review: Check no semantic/claim change and identify affected physical artifacts
qa_consequence: Targeted physical/distribution QA; full Step20 only if risk/meaning changed
version_consequence: New physical version if distributed artifact bytes change; old version preserved

definition: Bounded factual/wording correction that does not alter analytical decision, scope or recommendation class
examples_of_effect: Fix a mislabeled heading or bounded explanatory wording while decision remains identical
minimum_impact_review: Trace affected client surfaces and confirm no analytical dependency change
qa_consequence: Targeted consistency + physical QA; escalate if meaning/decision changes
version_consequence: New version if distributed artifact changes
provider_rule: No provider call unless correction itself requires new evidence

definition: Change to semantic mapping, page role, action, priority claim, limitation, evidence interpretation or other analytical conclusion
examples_of_effect: Change page owner, remove/add action, change HOLD state, alter AI/Search conclusion
minimum_impact_review: Identify exact upstream authority and all downstream dependents
qa_consequence: Reopen affected analytical step(s), regenerate downstream artifacts, fresh Step20 on new release candidate
provider_rule: New provider evidence only with separate authorization if genuinely required

definition: Request changes frozen commission, region, deliverable scope, business goal or adds materially new work
examples_of_effect: New region, new service line, new output class, broader site/market scope
minimum_impact_review: Compare request to frozen order and estimate affected roadmap/evidence/cost
qa_consequence: Reopen Step0/scope governance then redesign affected downstream workflow
provider_rule: Provider plan must be separately re-authorized if scope changes acquisition

definition: New information suggests current site/business state changed; analytical method may still be valid but current-world evidence may be stale
examples_of_effect: Site deploy, URL redirect, offer removed/added, business scope changed
minimum_impact_review: Identify affected current-world evidence and expiration trigger
qa_consequence: Refresh affected current-site/Step20 checks first; change analysis only if new evidence contradicts it
version_consequence: No version change if refresh confirms existing package; new version if package changes
provider_rule: Provider call only if refresh requires separately authorized provider evidence
